neutral_component_scope: Start with the timer-named source file, common source/header names, heap-named header, and public header. Platform-specific implementations remain outside the initial slice.
discovery_exclusions: externally maintained libraries identified in LICENSE-extra

scope_limits.closure: Later confirm platform/common boundaries and immediate caller/helper closure. Do not infer cross-platform behavior from the common-file slice.

goal: Later bounded source-grounded verification/specification assessment of this filename-defined native-library slice; actionable handoff or no-new-work without predetermined properties.
adoption: Read-only planning only; no target production changes or execution without separate actual owner grants and applicable isolation.

license_locators: LICENSE-extra applicability paragraphs and external-library list
provenance.license_interpretation: MIT root grant and MIT-originating extra notice inspected. LICENSE-extra separately identifies BSD-2-Clause tree.h and ISC implementations in src/inet.c. Documentation licensing was not inspected; docs are excluded.

uncertainties: No timer-specific test filename was enumerated; later bounded test discovery is prerequisite work.
SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS.md is an uninspected requirement lead, not established platform support evidence.
Semantic version, native dependencies, configuration selection, concurrency and FFI applicability unexamined.
Per-file licensing closure and platform implementation closure remain unverified.
Catalog membership and assessment outcome unexamined.
identity_basis: Pinned Git commit/tree plus independently clean working tree and tracked object inventory; not a SHA-256 digest of every working-tree file
